name: DeepDown
source:
"Deep Down" is a story-driven game that follows the life of a young woman named April, who is just 19 years old and currently studying at university. However, April is a total bookworm who has never really explored the wilder side of life. Her roommate and best friend, Faith, sees something special in April and is determined to help her (not without some help) break out of her shell and discover her true potential "deep down" inside her.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/deepdownvn/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Deep Down》是一款故事驱动游戏，讲述了一位名叫April的年轻女子的生活，她年仅19岁，目前正在大学学习。然而，阿普丽尔是个十足的书呆子，从未真正探索过生活中更狂野的一面。她的室友兼最好的朋友费思在四月看到了一些特别的东西，并决心帮助她（在没有帮助的情况下）打破她的外壳，发现她内心“深处”的真正潜力。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/deepdownvn/about]Patreon[/url]]
